scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Land Rover LR3 / Discovery 3?
265/65R18 or 285/60R18 (≈31 in)
scenes.body: Fit at factory height on 18-inch wheels.

scenes.title: 275/65R18 (≈32 in)
scenes.body: The common choice with Proud Rhino, Johnson or Terrafirma rods; may rub slightly at full lock, cured by heat-reshaping…

scenes.eyebrow: With a +2 in coil conversion lift
scenes.title: 32–33 in
scenes.body: Lucky8 says Terrafirma's HD coil conversion clears 32–33 in tyres with minor trimming, depending on wheels and offset.
